biggest_cut: The proof of Proposition 20 is longer than it needs to be: the explicit partition, the Abel-summation bookkeeping through Lemma 19 (which is itself just routine summation by parts) and the Riemann-sum limit could all be replaced by one Stieltjes-integral/summation-by-parts line against the bound D(v) ≤ √v r_q.
